maria_ux: Heads up — I merged an exports map change to sdk-js on main and it looks like onboarding samples running in edge runtimes started failing. Repro steps below.
ajay_sdk: What specifically changed?
maria_ux: We switched to a conditional exports map to prefer node ESM and provide types. Snippet:```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./feature": "./dist/node/feature.mjs"
}
```
tim_infra: Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Worker / Deno / Bun edge) try to resolve the package but fail because they don't honor the "node" conditional. Error in Worker console: `Uncaught TypeError: Failed to resolve import '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/node/index.mjs'` — basically the runtime hits the conditional and there's no fallback for non-node.
lisa_types: Also seeing tsc errors in quickstarts — the `types` path is under the node conditional so TS resolver can't find the global `index.d.ts`. `error TS6053: File '.../node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/types/index.d.ts' not found.`
ajay_sdk: Quick fix: add explicit fallbacks for edge/browser/deno and expose a root types entry. Example suggestion to patch exports:```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "deno": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "browser": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
maria_ux: Another related pain — some of our sample repos still use `require('@redwood/sdk-js')` or `const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk-js')` which trips when package.json has `type: \"module\"`. Users hit `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`. :weary:
tim_infra: For short-term we can publish a compatibility CJS build and add a `require` target under `exports.".".node.require` or keep a `main` fallback pointing to `dist/node/index.cjs`. That unblocks quickstarts while we stabilize the ESM-first exports.
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy failed: onboarding-samples (branch: main) — 8/12 edge sample runs errored due to unresolved import map. Logs attached to the ticket.
maria_ux: Can someone own a small PR to add `deno/worker/browser` fallbacks + top-level `./types` export and publish a patch? I'll open the ticket and link samples.
ajay_sdk: I'll take it. Will draft PR with exports patch + add a note in CHANGELOG about edge compat and add simple repro in devex/canary-samples.
lisa_types: Thanks — add a quick TS test that resolves types from a clean node_modules to avoid regressions.
maria_ux: Great. Also adding a tiny note in onboarding guide about prefer `import` for ESM runtimes and a compatibility section for CJS consumers.
